guide.title: How to get your page ready
guide.intro: Your page is a short link with your socials and your style. Everything you change stays as a draft until you publish it.

steps.profile: upload your photo (or use your channel's), write your display name and a short bio.
steps.links: add your socials from the list and any links you want, sort them and hide the ones you do not want to show yet.
steps.appearance: choose one of the five templates (Scene, Badge, TV channel, Inventory or Poster), a light or dark theme, the accent color and the font.
steps.name: check your @name. You can change it once every 30 days.
steps.publish: tap «Publish» so your page shows the changes. «Discard changes» takes the draft back to what is published.

notes.draft: The preview on the right shows the draft; your public link shows only what is published.
notes.handle: When you change your name, the old one leads to your new page for 30 days. After that it is free for someone else.
notes.appeal: If someone else already has your name, you can send an appeal from the Name tab. The Decatron team reviews it.
notes.links: Links must start with https://. Each network only accepts addresses from that network (for example, Instagram only accepts instagram.com). Link shorteners (bit.ly, tinyurl…) aren't accepted because they hide where the link goes.
notes.adult: If your page or a link leads to content for people 18 or older, mark it as 18+ (in Profile for the whole page, or on each link). Known adult sites are marked automatically and can't be unmarked. No adult photos or videos are uploaded to Decatron: only links.
notes.permissions: You and anyone with full control of your channel can edit your page.
notes.templates: All five templates use the same content: you can switch templates any time without losing anything. Inventory and Poster also use each link's size.
notes.reports: Anyone who is signed in can report a page. The Decatron team reviews reports: nothing is hidden automatically, and if your page is hidden you'll see the reason at the top of this panel.
